_note: Uno Minda reports one segment under Ind AS 108 (auto components). The company discloses revenue by product division in its presentations and calls (Rs crore, consolidated). From Q4FY26 the divisions were reconfigured: Green Mobility (EV systems, UMAI 4W EV, EV controllers, alternate fuel/Westport) was carved out, and acoustics moved into Others; the company restated Q4FY25-Q3FY26 on the new basis. Earlier quarters are not available on this basis (gap). Q1FY26 divisions exclude Rs69 cr of prior-period income booked in revenue (reported revenue Rs4,489 cr). FY26 divisional totals sum to Rs19,589 cr (reported Rs19,658 cr incl. that income). FY25: Switches (Rs4,204 cr) and Green Mobility (Rs1,313 cr) as stated; Lighting, Castings, Seating and Others derived from the stated FY26 growth rates (14%, 15%, 23%, 26%), so they sum to Rs16,758 cr vs Rs16,775 cr reported. No divisional profit is disclosed.
